segments.title: Chương 36: 0036【Mình Đúng Là Soái Ca】
segments.content:
On the weekend, the temperature dropped even lower.

It was the time of Minor Snow in the twenty-four solar terms.

"Ding-ling-ling-ling…"

An urgent alarm clock rang early in the morning.

Xie Yang covered his head with the quilt and cursed, "Which idiot set the alarm?"

"Your grandpa!"

Chen Guiliang turned over and sat up. He was going shopping today; Bian Guanyue was helping him pick out clothes.

Yang Hao also got up. He was the most hardworking in Dorm 302, but his exam scores were about the same as Xie Yang's.

"What time is it?" Liu Zhihong asked groggily.

Chen Guiliang said, "Seven-thirty."

As soon as he said that, everyone burst out cursing. Even Yang Hao lay back down.

It was a day off, so of course they had to sleep in.

Liu Zhihong complained, "Daxia Chen, have you gone mad? Who the hell sets an alarm on a weekend?"

"Magic cape? I might as well be Harry Potter." Chen Guiliang pulled on his pants and jumped down.

Xu Haibo asked, "Where are you going so early?"

Chen Guiliang said smugly, "I have a date to go shopping with a girl."

"Damn!"

Several people in the dorm sat up at once.

Xu Haibo asked, "Are you going on a date with Bian Guanyue or Tao Xue?"

"That's a secret."

Chen Guiliang walked to the full-length mirror and admired his reflection, finding himself more handsome the more he looked.

He had weighed himself at the pharmacy yesterday and had gained up to 120.4 jin, so his cheeks no longer looked sunken.

Li Yulin actively offered to help, "You can borrow that windbreaker by my bed today. I've only worn it once since I bought it."

Chen Guiliang said, "No need. Thanks."

"Why be so polite with me?" Li Yulin said persuasively, "I'm experienced when it comes to dating girls. I'm not saying you have to wear high-end brands, but you can't be too shabby either. Don't embarrass the girl when you're walking on the street. Your few jackets are so worn and old, they don't match Bian Guanyue at all."

Xu Haibo reminded him, "Daxia Chen, you should also get a haircut."

The other guys in Dorm 302 also chimed in one after another, helping Chen Guiliang plan his first date.

Chen Guiliang felt a warmth in his heart; this kind of dorm friendship was unadulterated.

Xie Yang thought to himself: What do you guys know? Daxia Chen is running a private server, he's about to become a rich man!

Chen Guiliang strolled out of the school gate. While he was waiting for the bus, Tao Chenggang called.

"Are you up?" Tao Chenggang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "Just woke up."

Tao Chenggang said, "I went to Rongcheng yesterday and asked a friend to find me a well-known lawyer. I had dinner with him last night, we chatted while we ate, and I've already gotten a clear picture of the situation."

"Running a private server won't land me in jail, will it?" Chen Guiliang didn't think it would, but he was still a little unsure.

Tao Chenggang said cheerfully:

"Haha, it won't."

"That lawyer said that the only current regulation involving the internet and electronic products is the copyright law amended two years ago. But copyright is different from intellectual property rights. The copyright for Legend is in the hands of the Korean developer. Shanda only has the agency and operation rights for Legend in mainland China."

"For internet and electronic product agents and operators, there are no regulations that strictly define their responsibilities and rights yet. The law in this area is very vague, it's not even clear if Shanda can sue. The only thing for sure is that the Korean developer can sue us for infringement."

"But Shanda and the Korean side had a falling out long ago. Their reconciliation was only on the surface; the Korean side isn't even providing Shanda with subsequent versions. If we set up a private Legend server, the Korean side would probably be happy to see Shanda take a hit."

"If they could get people arrested and jailed, Shanda would have gone through legal procedures long ago. Why would they need to resort to hackers out of sheer rage and embarrassment?"

The legislation for a new phenomenon follows a gradual process:

In 2001, the copyright for internet and electronic products was established. In 2005, the responsibilities of operators and agents were standardized. In 2006, the rights and interests of operators and agents were determined.

To date, the responsibilities of Shanda as the agent operator for Legend have not even been standardized yet!

Let alone protecting their rights and interests.

At most, they could persuade the relevant authorities to carry out a special rectification campaign to clean up the market environment a bit.

As for Shanda using hackers to attack private servers, that started back at the end of 2002.

At that time, there weren't many private servers. Any private server that publicly disclosed its IP address was attacked by Shanda's hackers.

Later, as the server-side localization improved, more and more new tools were developed. Especially with the development of the M2 modification tool, setting up a private server became something anyone could do, and the number of private servers exploded.

New private servers popped up every day, and the hackers were simply too busy to keep up, so Shanda had no choice but to give up.

Chen Guiliang was a little worried, "We've gotten so big now, we've probably already been noticed by Shanda. What if we get attacked by Shanda's hackers before we even recover our costs?"

Tao Chenggang's smile vanished in an instant, "If we really do get attacked by hackers, we can only count ourselves unlucky."

"Big companies aren't that quick to react. It shouldn't be hard to recover our costs," Chen Guiliang comforted Tao Chenggang, and himself at the same time.

The two of them fell silent over the phone.

Neither of them had expected that a single promotional advertorial would actually go viral.

Sometimes, too much of a good thing can be bad.

It could also be called being too clever for one's own good.

Chen Guiliang hung up the phone when the bus arrived and took it to the designated meeting spot.

He'd deal with future problems when they arose, playing it by ear.

Chen Guiliang wasn't one to wallow in worry and fear all day long.

The county town wasn't large, and the old district was a crowded mess. A new district had been developed in the last two years, but the new area was just that one main road.

The housing prices in the new residential areas were around 800, and the most expensive ones didn't exceed 1000.

After a few stops, Chen Guiliang got off in the new district and looked around for Bian Guanyue.

Bian Guanyue was sitting on a bench by the roadside, listening to Stefanie Sun and Jay Chou on her MP3 player.

Back when she was in Rongcheng, she would occasionally go shopping with friends.

But they were all girls.

This was the first time with a boy.

"Chen Guiliang, over here!"

Seeing a familiar figure get off the bus, Bian Guanyue quickly stood up and waved her hand prettily at him.

Chen Guiliang strode over and asked, "Have you had breakfast?"

"I have," Bian Guanyue said.

Chen Guiliang nodded, "Perfect, let's have breakfast together."

Bian Guanyue: "..."

Of course, that was a joke. Chen Guiliang ran to a roadside breakfast stall and bought some soy milk and steamed buns.

Bian Guanyue said, "I'm not familiar with the new district, I don't know where to buy clothes."

"Then let's just walk and look," Chen Guiliang said.

The two walked side by side, a rather disjointed sight.

The girl was as beautiful as a flower, dressed in expensive clothes from head to toe.

The boy was completely unkempt, his hair probably hadn't been cut in two months, and his clothes, pants, and shoes were all shabby. Moreover, he was eating while walking, gobbling down his food without any regard for his image.

"What price range of clothes are you thinking of buying?" Bian Guanyue asked tentatively.

Chen Guiliang said, "As long as it fits, I don't mind."

Bian Guanyue said, "If it's too expensive, you don't have to rush to pay back the money I lent you."

"Sure, then I'll get a whole designer outfit," Chen Guiliang said jokingly.

Seeing that he wasn't self-conscious about his poverty, Bian Guanyue stopped being so cautious and even teased with a smile, "You're not one to be modest."

Chen Guiliang took the opening and ran with it, "What's there to be formal about between us? I'm Qin Shi Huang, and you're the future Empress of Qin. No matter how much of your money I spend, it counts as startup capital."

"Don't take advantage of me, I'm not going to be an empress," Bian Guanyue was no fool.

The two of them chatted idly, and soon they had walked through most of the commercial street in the new district.

There were no brand-name clothing stores for young people…

Even for brands like Yishion and Metersbonwe, it would be another three or four years before they opened stores here.

When Metersbonwe opened a store in the county town, it even caused a buying frenzy among the youth.

This blasted county town was too backward!

"Let's go with this one," Chen Guiliang pointed to a Double Star specialty store.

It was quite ridiculous; this specialty store was fake, just using the Double Star name.

Only about a quarter of the store sold Double Star clothes and shoes. The other areas of the shop were filled with various miscellaneous brands of men's and women's clothing. Chen Guiliang even saw Nike.

"Are you two looking to buy clothes or shoes?"

The female shopkeeper was particularly enthusiastic, and she eyed them curiously, her mind conjuring up a story of a poor boy wooing a rich girl.

Chen Guiliang's skin was incredibly thick. He said to Bian Guanyue, "It's your time to shine. I'm not very good at picking clothes."

Bian Guanyue looked at Chen Guiliang seriously, thinking about how best to put an outfit together.

"You seem to have gained some weight," Bian Guanyue said.

Chen Guiliang said, "Not enough yet, I've only gained up to 120 jin. For my height, a weight of one-thirty or one-forty would be normal."

Once he returned to a standard weight, Chen Guiliang really would be a handsome guy.

Bian Guanyue quickly brought over three jackets—a stand-collar one, a hoodie, and a windbreaker—and held them up against Chen Guiliang, comparing them.

The shopkeeper helped from the side, adding her sales pitch, "Your boyfriend has a great figure, he looks handsome in anything. This stand-collar jacket would go best with a pair of casual pants…"

"He's not my boyfriend," Bian Guanyue corrected.

Chen Guiliang said with a serious expression, "We have a purely platonic relationship as classmates."

The shopkeeper smiled at them with an "I get it" expression.

Bian Guanyue quickly put together two sets of clothes and pants, feeling quite proud of her work, "How about we buy both sets?"

Chen Guiliang said, "You're the boss."

Bian Guanyue then went and picked out two pairs of sneakers.

"Can I use a card?"

"Yes, this way, please."

The shopkeeper furiously punched numbers into a calculator, "Two jackets, two pairs of pants, two pairs of sneakers, a total of 1356 yuan. I'll round it down for you, 1350 will do."

"If you're rounding down, might as well round to an even number. 1000 yuan is just right," Chen Guiliang casually bargained.

For this kind of fake specialty store, who knew where they got their stock. Haggling down to 800 yuan wouldn't be outrageous.

The shopkeeper said, "Handsome, we don't bargain here."

"You already called me handsome, shouldn't a handsome guy get a little discount?" Chen Guiliang smiled.

The shopkeeper said, "We really don't bargain in our store."

Bian Guanyue stood to the side, a little embarrassed. She was thin-skinned and felt a bit ashamed.

To her surprise, after Chen Guiliang went back and forth a few times, the shopkeeper actually agreed to round it down to one thousand yuan.

Chen Guiliang took the clothes, pants, and shoes to the fitting room, saying to Bian Guanyue as he passed her, "You can pay first, wait for me to change into my battle armor."

He had money in his card now, but he still had Bian Guanyue pay.

A gentleman's word is his bond. He said he'd borrow money to buy clothes, how could he go back on his word?

After a short while, Chen Guiliang came out wearing a new set of clothes. Bian Guanyue looked him over carefully, "Something's still missing."

The shopkeeper said, "The hairstyle."

"Right, the hairstyle," Bian Guanyue asked, "How long has it been since you cut your hair?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I don't know."

When he was a student, he saved wherever he could, and haircuts were no exception. He'd get a buzz cut and let it grow naturally until it was absolutely necessary to cut it again.

Bian Guanyue took him to a nearby hair salon and said to the Tony-laoshi, "A little shorter, make him look more sunny."

The Tony-laoshi gave him a crew cut.

After the cut, Chen Guiliang stood there, and Bian Guanyue's eyes lit up.

She had to admit that with the added weight, new clothes, and new hairstyle, Chen Guiliang was indeed a little handsome.

(Please give me your collections and monthly tickets.)
